$comment: Machine-readable stack contract for Fashion Asia. Written by /adapt on 2026-09-28 from detect-stack.mjs plus verification against package.json/package-lock.json. Scripts (worktree.sh, gen-inventory.mjs, post-edit.sh) read THIS; agents read docs/STACK.md. Keep the two in sync; change the stack via /stack-change.

_gateNotes.lint: Suspended, not dropped: `npm run lint` runs `next lint`, which Next 16 no longer provides, and only a legacy .eslintrc.json exists (docs/WORKFLOW.md §7 #1). Re-add the day a working lint command lands.
_gateNotes.test: No test runner is installed. Adding one needs an architect-reviewer decision.
_gateNotes.e2e: None installed. /qa live uses curl plus headless Chrome over CDP, driven by scripts kept in the session scratchpad.

db.schemaChangeFlow: Hand-written SQL in db/migrations/<NNNN>_<slug>.sql with a '-- STATUS: PENDING_USER_APPLY' header. The owner applies it in the Supabase SQL editor (there is no Supabase CLI). HARD STOP until the owner confirms, then the header flips to '-- STATUS: APPLIED <date>'. supabase-schema.sql is the rolled-up snapshot.
db.typegenNote: No generated types. Row and settings types are hand-written in src/lib/site-content.ts and the action files.
db.authzNote: RLS policies: anon has SELECT (plus INSERT on submissions); authenticated has ALL. Every writing Server Action also calls supabase.auth.getUser() first (app layer). There is no admin role: ANY authenticated account is an admin (RISKS R1), so Supabase sign-ups must stay OFF.

deployNote: Vercel builds production from GitHub main. Both remotes are pushed together, only via /ship on an owner 'deploy': client (happierbangladesh/Fashion_Asia_Limited) gets main, authored by happierbangladesh; origin (AdilAhmedAhir/Fashion_Asia_Limited) gets its mirror publish/origin-main, authored by AdilAhmedAhir (.claude/scripts/mirror-authorship.mjs). Same files, different commit ids, no co-author lines. Live on www.fal.com.bd = www.fashionasialtd.com.
_formatNote: The post-edit hook's format and lint step is off: Prettier isn't installed, and ESLint 9 can't read the legacy config, so running them would flag every edit. The hook's secret guard still runs on every edit.
